text: 摩根大通发表研报指出，中金公司A股及H股上日(8日)分别下跌3%及7%，跑输A股及H股券商同业约2个百分点及5个百分点。该行认为，弱势主要由合并相关技术性因素驱动，而非基本面恶化，现水平可视为买入机会；事件驱动资金流影响应随交易接近完成而逐步消退，而该行料中金公司第三季经营趋势可强于同业。 中金已获证监会批准与东兴证券及信达证券合并，该行估计合并在静态基础上或对每股盈利及股本回报率构成高单位数至低双位数百分比拖累，但预期2027年股本回报率可回升至11.9%，因合并协同效应(主要透过资产负债表再杠杆)可抵销摊薄。第三季业绩或成催化剂，受惠于零售经纪敞口相
text_en: JPMorgan research note: CICC's A-shares and H-shares fell 3% and 7% respectively last session (8th), underperforming A-share and H-share brokerage peers by roughly 2 and 5 percentage points. The bank believes the weakness is driven mainly by merger-related technical factors rather than fundamental deterioration, and current levels can be seen as a buying opportunity; event-driven fund flow impacts should gradually fade as the deal nears completion, while the bank expects CICC's Q3 operating trends to be stronger than peers. CICC has received CSRC approval to merge with Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities; the bank estimates the merger could drag EPS and ROE by high-single-digit to low-double-digit percentages on a static basis, but expects ROE to recover to 11.9% in 2027 as merger synergies (mainly via balance sheet re-leveraging) offset dilution. Q3 results could act as a catalyst, benefiting from relatively higher retail brokerage exposure...
